highlights.title: Musk Says Tesla, SpaceX, xAI Chip Project to Kick Off in Texas
highlights.description: Elon Musk said his Terafab project — a grand plan to eventually manufacture his own chips for robotics, artificial intelligence and space data centers — will be built in Austin and jointly run by Tesla and SpaceX.

highlights.title: OpenAI Plans Desktop App Fusing Chat, Coding and Web Browser
highlights.description: OpenAI is developing a desktop application to bring together its ChatGPT chatbot, coding tool and web browser in an effort to keep users engaged in the face of fierce competition from rivals like Anthropic PBC.

highlights.title: China’s ‘AI tigers’ see shares surge after Nvidia CEO touts OpenClaw as ‘next ChatGPT’
highlights.description: Chinese AI stocks surged on Wednesday following upbeat remarks from Nvidia's chief executive Jensen Huang on the promise of AI agents and OpenClaw.

highlights.title: Anthropic just shipped an OpenClaw killer called Claude Code Channels, letting you message it over Telegram and Discord
highlights.description: The hit open source autonomous AI agent OpenClaw may have just gotten mogged by Anthropic. Today, Anthropic announced Claude Code Channels, a way to hook up its own powerful Claude Code AI agentic harness to a human user's Discord or Telegram messaging applications, letting them message Claude Code directly whenever they want while on the go and instruct it to write code for them. highlights.title: OpenAI is planning a desktop ‘superapp’
highlights.description: OpenAI is working on a desktop "superapp" that merges its ChatGPT app, the Codex AI coding app, and its AI-powered Atlas browser into one app, The Wall Street Journal reports. The company is making the change as part of an effort to simplify its various product efforts, according to a memo cited by the WSJ from Fidji Simo, OpenAI's CEO of Applications. highlights.title: Justice Department Says Anthropic Can’t Be Trusted With Warfighting Systems
highlights.description: In response to Anthropic’s lawsuit, the government said it lawfully penalized the company for trying to limit how its Claude AI models could be used by the military.

highlights.title: Alibaba, Tencent Shares Lose $66 Billion as AI Vision Falls Flat
highlights.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. and Tencent Holdings Ltd. lost $66 billion of market value in roughly 24 hours, after the market punished the twin leaders of China’s tech arena for failing to lay out clear visions for how to profit off artificial intelligence.

highlights.title: OpenAI to create desktop super app, combining ChatGPT app, browser and Codex app
highlights.description: The new unified app aims to help OpenAI streamline the user experience.

highlights.title: Big Tech purchases of carbon credits explode amid AI race, with Microsoft leading the way
highlights.description: Carbon credit purchases by Amazon, Google, Meta and Microsoft skyrocketed in 2023, based on tracked purchases.

highlights.title: OpenAI is putting ChatGPT, its browser and code generator into one desktop app
highlights.description: OpenAI is developing a “super app” for desktop that unifies ChatGPT, its browser and its Codex app, according to the Wall Street Journal and CNBC. A company spokesperson told the publications that OpenAI Chief of Applications Fidji Simo will lead the application revamp with assistance from OpenAI President Greg Brockman. Simo will also help the marketing team advertise the app when it comes out. OpenAI’s leadership is apparently hoping that combining several products can help it streamline user

chips_cloud.title: Musk Says Tesla, SpaceX, xAI Chip Project to Kick Off in Texas
chips_cloud.description: Elon Musk said his Terafab project — a grand plan to eventually manufacture his own chips for robotics, artificial intelligence and space data centers — will be built in Austin and jointly run by Tesla and SpaceX.

chips_cloud.title: Nvidia Says Company Firing Up H200 Production for China
chips_cloud.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says the company has been licensed for “many customers in China” for H200 sales and is in the process of “restarting our manufacturing.” Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

chips_cloud.title: Dell updates Alienware gaming laptops with Intel’s Arrow Lake-HX Refresh CPUs — 16-inch models receive OLED display and GPU upgrades
chips_cloud.description: Dell expands Alienware 16 Area-51, Alienware 16X Aurora, and Alienware 18 Area-51 laptops with new Intel Arrow Lake-HX Refresh processor options.

chips_cloud.title: U.S. prosecutors charge Super Micro Computer employees with smuggling Nvidia chips to China
chips_cloud.description: The U.S. government has been trying to crack down on illegal shipments of top-tier Nvidia artificial intelligence chips to China.

chips_cloud.title: Nvidia Partner Hon Hai’s Profit Miss Raises AI Demand Fears
chips_cloud.description: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. posted a 2.4% drop in quarterly profit, suggesting weakening demand for Nvidia Corp. servers at the heart of the AI boom.

chips_cloud.title: Data Center Firm DayOne Seeks to Boost Loan to Record $7 Billion
chips_cloud.description: DayOne Data Centers Ltd. is seeking to double the size of an existing loan to as much as $7 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, in what would be the largest borrowing for the sector by any firm in Asia.

chips_cloud.title: Memory Chip Crunch to Persist Until 2030, SK Chairman Says
chips_cloud.description: A global shortage of memory chips is likely to persist another four to five years because of endemic constraints in semiconductor production, the head of South Korean conglomerate SK Group said.

ai.description: Chinese shares related to OpenClaw jumped, buoyed by bullish comments from Nvidia Corp.’s chief on the potential of artificial intelligence agents.

ai.title: Trump Officials Fire Back at Anthropic Over AI Tool Ban
ai.description: The Trump administration vowed a legal fight to oust Anthropic PBC from all US government agencies following a dispute over how the company’s artificial intelligence technology would be used.

ai.title: New court filing reveals Pentagon told Anthropic the two sides were nearly aligned — a week after Trump declared the relationship kaput
ai.description: Anthropic submitted two sworn declarations to a California federal court late Friday afternoon, pushing back on the Pentagon's assertion that the AI company poses an "unacceptable risk to national security" and arguing that the government's case relies on technical misunderstandings and claims that were never actually raised during the months of negotiations.

ai.title: Investors Turn to AI to Find an Edge in Iran War Fallout
ai.description: Investors are turning to AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude to try to understand the evolving complexities of the war in the Middle East. It's the first time AI is being used in this way. Ruth Carson explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

ai.title: Xiaomi Shares Jump on AI Model Buzz, Upcoming SU7 Model Facelift
ai.description: Xiaomi Corp. shares rallied Thursday after the company released its latest artificial intelligence models and as it prepared to launch a refreshed version of its SU7 electric vehicle.

ai.title: Alibaba AI Business Is ‘Free Call Option,’ First Eagle Fund Says
ai.description: Alibaba Group Holdings Ltd.’s share price is only factoring in the company’s e-commerce business, not its artificial intelligence potential, says the manager of a $17 billion fund.

ai.title: Anthropic Denies It Could Sabotage AI Tools During War
ai.description: The Department of Defense alleges the AI developer could manipulate models in the middle of war. Company executives argue that’s impossible.

ai.title: Meta's Manus launches desktop app to bring its AI agent onto personal devices amid OpenClaw craze
ai.description: Manus has announced the launch of a new desktop application to bring its AI agent directly onto personal devices.

ai.title: Alibaba Creates AI Tool for Companies to Ride China Agent Craze
ai.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. plans to release an agentic AI service for companies, banking on national enthusiasm around artificial intelligence assistants like OpenClaw that help users perform actual tasks.

ai.title: Palantir AI System Wins Key Pentagon Status, Reuters Reports
ai.description: The US Defense Department will establish Palantir Technologies Inc.’s Maven AI system as a “program of record,” Reuters reported on Friday night, as the Pentagon rapidly integrates the technology into its combat operations.

ai.title: Google, Accel India accelerator chooses 5 startups and none are ‘AI wrappers’
ai.description: Google and Accel say about 70% of AI startup pitches tied to India were "wrappers" as they reviewed more than 4,000 applications for their Atoms cohort.

ai.title: Meta’s latest AI improves its terrible content moderation, just a little
How China is getting everyone on OpenClaw, from gearheads to grandmas
ai.description: China's OpenClaw use is soaring as tech giants hold meet-ups to help everyone add the artificial intelligence digital assistant to their devices.

ai.title: HSBC Weighs Job Cuts From Multiyear AI-Fueled Overhaul
ai.description: HSBC is said to be considering a wave of deep job cuts over the coming years as CEO Georges Elhedery bets on AI to shrink its middle and back office footprint. Bloomberg's Adam Haigh reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

ai.title: StanChart’s AI Chief Exiting Less Than a Year After Joining
ai.description: The executive leading Standard Chartered Plc’s adoption of artificial intelligence is leaving the emerging markets lender less than a year into his role, according to people familiar with the matter.

business.title: China’s ‘AI tigers’ see shares surge after Nvidia CEO touts OpenClaw as ‘next ChatGPT’
business.description: Chinese AI stocks surged on Wednesday following upbeat remarks from Nvidia's chief executive Jensen Huang on the promise of AI agents and OpenClaw.

business.title: Apple CEO Praises China Partners as Beijing Applies Pressure
business.description: Apple Inc. Chief Executive Officer Tim Cook commended Chinese developers and the company’s partners in the country, days after the ruling party’s flagship newspaper criticized the iPhone maker for monopolistic policies.

business.title: Elon Musk misled Twitter investors ahead of $44 billion acquisition, jury says
business.description: Elon Musk was sued in late 2022 after completing his acquisition of Twitter, which he later renamed X.

business.title: AI Startup Yotta Seeks $4 Billion Valuation Ahead of Planned IPO
business.description: Yotta Data Services Pvt., the data center operator that runs India’s largest cluster of Nvidia Corp. AI processors, is seeking to raise fresh capital at a valuation of about $4 billion as it prepares to file its draft prospectus for an initial public offering.

business.title: Baidu-Backed BioMap Is Said to Confidentially File for HK IPO
business.description: BioMap Beijing Intelligent Technology Co. has filed confidentially for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise a few hundred million dollars this year, according to people familiar with the matter.

business.title: Hong Kong Crypto Unicorn RedotPay Churns Executives in IPO Drive
business.description: RedotPay, a Hong Kong startup in the stablecoin payments space, is contending with executive turnover and sensitivities around its connections to mainland China as it seeks to raise up to $150 million just months after its last funding round.

business.title: Melinda French Gates on Leading With Integrity
business.description: Having navigated some of life’s most defining transitions, Melinda French Gates reflects on the choices that set her path—from Microsoft executive to philanthropist and now founder of Pivotal. She shares how values-based leadership, resilience and the courage to embrace “the next day” have guided her through change, power and public scrutiny. (Source: Bloomberg)

"There's so much left that we can do with the iPhone," said Cook. devices.title: Samsung to Stop Selling $2,899 TriFold Phone After Three Months
devices.description: Samsung Electronics Co. is winding down sales of its Galaxy Z TriFold smartphone after roughly three months on the market, suggesting the $2,899 device was always intended as more of a technological showcase than a cornerstone of the company’s mobile lineup.

devices.title: China’s Party Paper Urges Apple to Fix ‘Monopolistic’ Policies
devices.description: Apple Inc. needs to ease app store restrictions and fix “monopolistic” practices, the Chinese ruling party’s flagship newspaper said just days after the iPhone maker agreed to cut local app store fees in a major concession.

devices.title: Apple TV: Grey’s Anatomy alum joins The Morning Show’s season 5
devices.description: Following the recent news that Jeff Daniels (The Newsroom) will join The Morning Show’s upcoming season, Deadline reports that Jesse Williams (Grey’s Anatomy) will also be added to the show’s lineup. Here are the details. more…

devices.title: Brazil’s competition watchdog inquires Apple over iPhone NFC restrictions
devices.description: Apple has until the end of the month to respond to a set of technical and legal issues from CADE, Brazil’s competition watchdog over alleged anticompetitive rules tied to the iPhone’s NFC. Here are the details. more…

devices.title: Pixel Weather tweaks widget as new icons come to Google Clock 8.6
devices.description: Google has made a pair of weather tweaks to Pixel Weather and the Clock app (version 8.6). more…

devices.title: What’s new in Android’s March 2026 Google System Updates [U]
devices.description: The monthly “Google System Release Notes” primarily detail what’s new in Play services, Play Store, and Play system update across Android phones/tablets, Wear OS, Google/Android TV, Auto, and PC. Some features apply to end users, while others are aimed at developers. more…

devices.title: YouTuber upgrades MacBook Neo to 1TB, posts ASMR video of the process
devices.description: YouTube creator DirectorFeng is back with another ASMR-themed video in which they attempt to upgrade the storage on a new Apple device. Watch it below. more…

other.title: Two Palantir veterans just came out of stealth with $30 million and a Sequoia stamp of approval
other.description: The founders are worth paying attention to.

other.title: UK To Invest £1 Billion into Quantum Computing Research, Trials
other.description: The UK will spend more than £1 billion ($1.3 billion) on quantum computing research over the next four years, as governments boost investment into a technology that’s increasingly considered critical to national security.

other.title: Netflix’s ‘Frankenstein’ wins three Oscars, ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ wins two
other.description: “Frankenstein” won for Best Production Design, Best Costume Design, and Best Makeup and Hairstyling, while “KPop Demon Hunters” won for Best Animated Feature and Best Original Song.

other.title: JD.com takes on Amazon in Europe as China's e-commerce titans expand globally
other.description: JD.com is pushing same-day delivery and international brands as a way to help it compete with Amazon.

other.title: JD.com’s European Push Pits Chinese Retailer Against Amazon
other.description: JD.com Inc. is launching in the UK and other European countries, part of an overseas expansion as China’s answer to Amazon faces intense competition in its home market.

other.description: In 2010, Warren Buffett and Bill Gates launched a disarmingly simple campaign they called the Giving Pledge: a public commitment, open to the world’s wealthiest people, to give away more than half their fortune during their lifetime or upon their death. ev_autonomous.title: Geely Profit Beats Estimates as Sales Approach Those of BYD
ev_autonomous.description: Geely Automobile Holdings Ltd.’s full-year profit beat analyst estimates and climbed to a record as China’s second-largest carmaker closed in on market leader BYD Co.’s sales, thanks to the popularity of its EX2 hatchbacks and Zeekr sport utility vehicles.

regulation.description: After a chaotic week following the Justice Department's mid-trial settlement with Live Nation-Ticketmaster, the antitrust trial picked back up surprisingly smoothly on Monday - this time, with dozens of states leading the case. crypto.title: Australian Senate panel backs crypto regulation framework
crypto.description: The Senate Economics Legislation Committee said the proposed legislation will modernize digital assets regulatory framework.

crypto.title: Bitcoin’s derivatives-led rally is already unraveling. Prices are back below $75,000
crypto.description: Bitcoin briefly surged to a six-week high above $75,000 before quickly retreating, underscoring the fragility of the latest rally.
